title: MathConstruct: Challenging LLM Reasoning with Constructive Proofs
abstract: arXiv:2502.10197v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in mathematics, existing math benchmarks come with significant limitations. Many focus on problems with fixed ground-truth answers, and are often saturated due to problem simplicity or the viability of guessing or memorization. Crucially, they capture only a narrow subset of relevant math problems. To address this research gap, we introduce MathConstruct, a new benchmark of 121 challenging problems sourced from various math competitions, which targets constructive proofs, a widely encountered problem type requiring the construction of mathematical objects with specific properties. These proofs are particularly suitable for LLM evaluation, as solution correctness can be easily verified. translated_title: MathConstruct：用构造性证明挑战大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在数学领域展现出令人印象深刻的性能，但现有的数学基准测试存在显著的局限性。许多基准测试专注于具有固定标准答案的问题，并且往往因问题过于简单或可以通过猜测和记忆来解答而达到饱和状态。至关重要的是，它们仅涵盖相关数学问题中很小的一部分。为了弥补这一研究空白，我们引入了MathConstruct，这是一个包含121道来自各类数学竞赛的具有挑战性问题的全新基准测试，专注于构造性证明——这是一种广泛存在的问题类型，要求构造具有特定性质的数学对象。这类证明特别适合用于LLM评估，因为解答的正确性可以轻易验证。我们的自动化验证器还使MathConstruct能够生成问题变体，用于评估模型的鲁棒性。最先进的大语言模型仅能解决MathConstruct中60%的问题，这凸显了……
tldr: 该论文提出了MathConstruct——一个包含121道来自数学竞赛的构造性证明难题的全新基准测试，用于评估大语言模型的数学推理能力，并发现最先进的LLM仅能解决其中60%的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MathConstruct, a new benchmark of 121 challenging constructive proof problems from math competitions for evaluating LLM mathematical reasoning, finding that state-of-the-art LLMs solve only 60% of the problems.
